modalLead: Watch feeds: the One column news window shows one article at a time even when nothing is new, and adding a feed says what to expect.

items.text: One column is one article at a time, also when nothing is new. With Show news as → One column the window no longer falls back to a long list of every earlier entry: it walks them one by one.
Adding a feed says what to expect. A feed's existing entries count as seen, so news shows when the site publishes something new; the toast after saving now says so.
